newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-REAL MADRID DRAW 2-2 WITH BETIS IN THRILLER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-REAL MADRID DRAW 2-2 WITH BETIS IN THRILLER.

text.p: Spanish league leaders Real Madrid came from back from an early goal down to earn a 2-2 draw against Real Betis in a thrilling top-of-the-table clash on Saturday.
The result leaves Real Madrid nine points clear at the top ahead of Sunday's game between second-placed Barcelona and Racing Santander, with Betis a further point back.

The game started at a furious pace, and was just seven minutes old when former Real Madrid striker Alfonso Perez put Betis ahead. The home side struck back quickly to equalise through Predrag Mijatovic, who finished off a superb move down the right.
The second half began as a mirror image of the first, with Christian Panucci heading Real Madrid in front from a free-kick, before Finidi George did the same for Betis.
Goalkeeper Toni Prats kept Betis alive in a frantic final five minutes with a superb save from Brazilian defender Roberto Carlos.
